components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific/title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is combined with the last name to form the derived
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as flat input for
            backward compatibility, and always returned: on create it holds the
            composed, normalized address — equal to the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat
            input when only 'address' was supplied. Optional on input: an owner
            is valid when it supplies an address in either form (a non-blank
            'addressLine1', or this flat 'address'), plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            Optional first line of the owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present
            (non-blank); it is normalized on create — trimmed, whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded
            (ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE) — and returned in that form.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured address (unit, suite, etc.).
            When present it is normalized like 'addressLine1' and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped and 8 to 15 digits are required after the '+'. When a country
            code is given explicitly the national-number length must match that
            country ('+61' requires 9 national digits, '+1' requires 10), else the
            request is rejected with 400. So '0412 345 678' is stored and returned
            as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            four digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); an out-of-range
            postcode is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Optional when absent; stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only create flag. The householdId is derived deterministically
            from lastName and postcode, so an owner whose lastName and postcode
            match an existing owner is the same household. When true, such a second
            member is admitted and is not flagged as a possible duplicate;
            otherwise the request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI path of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by
                the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a space and the
                last name when a title is present, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains E.164.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a
                per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the
                number of owners already in that city at the time of registration.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the
                registrationDate (the fiscal year starting 1 July).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is labelled by the
                calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 2 Jul 2025 -> FY26).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Deterministic identifier shared by owners in the same household:
                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                lastName and the postcode. Owners with the same lastName and
                postcode resolve to the same value automatically. Null for owners
                with no postcode, who are a household of one.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '3F2A9C1B7D4E'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection: the lower-case
                SHA-256 hex digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new owner's
                whole identityKey equals an existing owner's, so two owners with
                the same last name and postcode but different telephones are both
                allowed (and instead flagged possibleDuplicate).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed at the time this owner
                was registered sharing the same firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero for a distinctly named owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, adds 2 when an email
                is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2 for a household
                of 3 or more, and adds 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year (the fiscal year starting 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5,
                and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
